cases.name: Work backward
cases.prompt: My museum slot is 14:00, check-in takes 15 minutes, and the trip from lunch takes 25 minutes. Plan the handoff.
expectations: Sets the latest lunch departure to 13:20.

cases.name: Repeat without booking data
cases.prompt: Turn my Saturday plan of train, museum, lunch and rest into a reusable mobile itinerary. I have no booking app.
expectations: Returns the four slot types in order.
Removes booking-specific particulars from the reusable template.
Makes no booking or synchronization claim.

cases.name: Expose a conflict
cases.prompt: My fixed tour ends at 13:50. Another fixed event starts at 14:00 and is 25 minutes away, no check-in needed.
expectations: Preserves the tour end and second event start.
Shows 14:15 as the earliest arrival after the tour.
Offers a decision about changing a commitment instead of pretending both fit.
